question: Avohass avocado oil manufacturer company
markdown:
Avohass
is a specialty brand and company founded in 2012 by Donald Jones and Amy Bowman
. It focuses exclusively on producing and sourcing premium, single-origin avocado oils, including extra virgin cold-pressed and high-heat refined varieties harvested from regions like Mexico, New Zealand, Kenya, and Europe
. You can view their full product range directly on the
⁠Avohass Official Website
